word.item: Aaa for my names, they call me reverend Mark Simbili Shinyosi.
Aaa a resident of Mahanga Makuchi sublocation.
Shaviringa location when we are in Hamisi district.
I want to say aaa story of hunters.
One day hunters found ogre disturbing.
hunters were gathering they take be it.
Then they followed ogre luhuluhuluhu the big ogre.
Luhuluhuluhu big ogre is there is disturbing people always, Boys abroad there block kooo big ogre.
That one is disturbing people always.
They found woman digging potato, uprooting potatoes.
Woman in potato you are digging potatoes.
It told her “mother, these people want to kill me.
She told it to sleep down.
She took her basket that she wanted to carry in potatoes.
People came “really ogre kooi woman it has moved where?
Woman “no that big thing passed long ago.
I have seen something running there.
It has passed, it has gone.
She confused hunters ways hunters went down the valley, They went up.
And woman has covered big ogre there.
She has kept on potato vines.
Hunters went while the woman was digging her potatoes.
Hunters went they finished nearly two to three hours.
It was evening time, it was evening.
Big ogre told her mother “you have assisted me now open.”
“woman, I even where I came from there people chasing me.
Speed that I was running in hunger has defeated me.
Woman I want what to eat.”
Woman carried potatoes and moved where ogre was.
Woman went and said, “we go home.”
Woman asked, “ogre what are you eating?
Ogre told woman, “my food is someone until I eat meat,
and meat that I eat is of someone.
Woman so I will find where meat?”
If you do not have meat, I am going to eat you.”
Hunters that were are where koi?
Ogre itself, I had covered it .
Someone was not there hearing her.
It did what it ate her.
When hunters were lost on the way, the woman confused them.
Then ogre asked her for food.
It told her it eats people.
And woman did not have meat.
So we are saying of they are chasing ogre, do not hide ogre not.
These issues are teaching when you have seen something bad, do not hide.
For example, we are in these villages .
with our children are thieves of bananas. Are thieves of sugar cane Thieves of hens.
This story is teaching us when you see that child, you try
to assist him early to stop those issues.
If he does not want to stop, you call authority.
It goes to give him discipline.
When you hide him, he will kill you.
When you hide him, he will steal from you.
It is the reason for that story.
Yes for my names I am Mark Simbiri the son to Shinyosi.
Being a resident of Mahanga in Makuchi sublocation Shaviringa location.
They call it Tiriki East I am in Hamisi district I want to say a story like this.
Where there are elders nothing gets wrong in the past time we had boys.
They want they are saying we have to rule.
And in the past times if someone was given leadership there was a cloth of leadership that they were dressing someone to look like a leader.
In the past the cloth that they were dressing someone was a skin an animal used to be killed.
A skin was removed from a cow.
And then that animal that skin is tied on the body of someone that wants to be a leader.
So the boys refused and said inorder for us to rule well we kill all the elders we chase all the elders.
We boys we want to lead we want to rein.
Now there came a time they chased elders they killed some eventually boys remained.
And the boys had heard the way someone is dressed a cloth for leadership.
They knew well it is a skin they went and looked for an animal that they will remove a skin that they will dress the leader.
And then they took their boy that they had made to be the leader.
They came and made him sit on a seat and then they took needles.
For knitting what this skin they want to tie on their leader this boy the skin for him to look like a leader completely.
To look like a leadership animal that they want.
Then they came they started taking the skin they started to put on this boy then they tied they tied and it is a skin that is coming from the cow and it is wet.
After tying then the leader was kept on a seat then the leader sat he wants to be dressed for him to start his leadership things.
After tying that cow skin because the because someone's body is also releasing warmth the sun is burning the cow skin dried on the body.
And because it was wet as it was drying it tightened the skin as it shrinks together as it tightens the skin as it shrinks together.
When it got to a drying point the young leader began screaming.
Really the cow skin that you put me in is pressing me.
The cow skin that you put me in is hurting me.
The cow skin that you put me in is hurting me they boys wondered what shall we do we seems not to have put it on well bring knives they took knives and started sharpening.
They came they want to cut this cow skin from the body of this young leader.
When they were cutting they could cut and hear no you have cut me they see the blood dripping when they were cutting no you have cut me they wondered weeeiya we shall not manage.
The leader is crying he is full of complete blood he is screaming the youths told each other weeiya what shall we do.
Where is an old man we ask him they said one old man has remained here it is five kilometers away.
They sent people to go and look for the old man they kept the old man on a horse cart it brought him.
The old man arrived and checked and told them no boys you have done a mistake they do not do like this.
A cow skin that they dress someone they do not dress him while it is wet you have to dry it.
And this one now you want to remove it look for water they looked for water in a big can.
In a big pot that was used in the past like a big tank they kept in that leader they cow skin got to the neck they asked him to sit in.
After the old man had given them advice he stayed in for two to three hours then he told them to start removing the ropes.

They started to remove the ropes they found that the ropes were getting off easily they started to remove they round the ropes were getting off easily what you mean it was just a simple task and we were finding trouble here.
The youths began respecting elders they realized where there are elders nothing gets spoiled.
So my story is teaching when you want to make something elders should be there.
You seek for advice from elders elders will help you youth hurt the other one with knives.
Youth cut someone's body youth messed with the cow skin for leadership because they did not get lessons from elders.
So leadership requires elders to be there to give advice.
When someone wants to rule elders should be there.
Elders to sit with the boy they tell him yes we have annointed you as a leader you walk like this you do like this you be like this leadership will be good.
But when we take leadership to ourself by force when youth take leadership by force they will not go with it anywhere the leadership will fade away the area will be spoiled.
They say where there are elders there is no wrong when wrong happens elders make it until it becomes a blessing until things balance.

In the past, in the years of the past, we had two bulls.
These bulls loved each other, these bulls were grazing together.
So one time, lion saw how these bulls were healthy.
The way they were huge, the way they were nice.
Lion thought of killing these bulls so that they do not exist.
wanting how to separate these bulls, they stop being together.
it seems these bulls loved each other.
It thought, "what I'm I going to tell these bulls?"
So that they separate so that I get a chance to kill them
He went to these bulls one day, it told them, "you bulls".
I see you love each other very much.
I see you are very wise people.
I see you cannot even leave each other.
The secret that you found is a big secret.
But I want to tell you one thing that you are in shortage.
Where you lack, you are lacking where.
When one bull goes to east.
And the other one goes to west.
You will eat well, you will grow healthy well.
You, your foolishness is that you are grazing together.
Your foolishness is that you are eating together.
Try today, one to go to west and the other one to go to east.
He graze as he goes, and the one going to east you graze as you go there.
And you who goes to west you graze as you go here.
Lion had the wisdom, when these bulls separate.
When this graze as it goes there, it is thinking of grazing to get fat.
The lion just follows it kills it there, it eats and finish.
Again when it will return here, this one does not know, again it follows and do what.
It kills and finish, lion succeeded.
To separate these bulls from grazing together.
These bulls in their foolishness, they thought truly when we separate.
The way lion is telling us, this land is big.
We graze, we would be very huge, until we have bodies like those of elephant.
When they separated, one graze and went to east.
When it got tired, it reached there, it fell, it killed, ate and finished.
It returned to the one that went to west.
It followed the bull got tired.
It fell down, it was held by lion, it was eaten and finished.
It happened that the lion has finished them.
So this story is teaching, if the two love each other.
If you are doing your nice things.
When someone tells you a word of gossip.
You understand it, you think over it.
So that you give your decision.
If it is not like that, an enemy can finish you.
